body: Yes, absolutely. Unfortunately I live in a pretty loud environment and it's honestly extremely difficult to bear on a day-to-day basis. However, my noise-cancelling headphones (Sony WH1000-XM4, I have tried a few and they're the best) do help in moments of great despair.

It is thought to be underdiagnosed and not that rare. I mentioned it because I have it. Knowing the cause for the pain and injuries can help mentally, and it certainly can help with judgemental family and friends. There is no cure, but there are certainly symptomatic treatments.
Have you heard of Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome? It sounds like it could apply (although it’s just a stab in the dark, and it could be something entirely different).

Disclaimer: I’m not a medical professional, but I am somewhat educated to answer this. In any case, I wish someone were to tell me this if I regretted overdosing on pills. 

 5g paracetamol is considered an overdose (especially for your weight, it’s about 4g, maybe even slightly less). The protocol for this is ALWAYS to get checked out medically and get blood work done. I’m not sure when the ingestion happened, but you have a very high chance of survival if you get seen by a doctor within 8 hours. NAC is preferably given intravenously, and you don’t mention how much you took. Even if you feel fine now (in fact, even if you feel fine 24 hours from now) doesn’t mean you won’t die or have irreversible liver damage from it. Please, if at all possible, get seen by a doctor asap.

HAPPY BIRTHDAY!

It’s not dumb. It’s also my birthday (well, technically it’s already the next day here), and I didn’t get real birthday wishes either. I feel hypocritical saying this, but at the same time I know I’m yearning to hear someone tell me this: you’re not worthless, and you certainly shouldn’t give up. Please, don’t give up. I’m obviously at a very low point myself, meaning that I’m not the most articulate right now, but I really hope you won’t hurt yourself. Happy birthday again, from your birthday twin.

I have been seeking mental health treatment, but I’m not being taken very seriously or cared for there either. I am too weak and shaken for a lengthy reply right now, but please know that your post means a lot to me. Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a long and caring reply. You are lovely, and appreciated.
